valo_acceptance_reviews_judgment.name: valo_acceptance_reviews_judgment
valo_acceptance_reviews_judgment.value:
("valo_acceptance_reviews"."judgment" = 'expected_outcome' AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."answer" IN ('confirmed', 'rejected')
          AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."run_id" IS NULL AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."results_hash" IS NULL)
        OR ("valo_acceptance_reviews"."judgment" = 'run_outcome' AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."answer" IN ('met', 'not_met')
          AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."results_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND length("valo_acceptance_reviews"."run_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "valo_acceptance_reviews"."results_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

valo_staff_expiry_shape.name: valo_staff_expiry_shape
valo_staff_expiry_shape.value: ("valo_staff_assignments"."grant_mode" = 'permanent' AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("valo_staff_assignments"."grant_mode" = 'break_glass' AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" >= "valo_staff_assignments"."granted_at" + interval '5 minutes' AND "valo_staff_assignments"."expires_at" <= "valo_staff_assignments"."granted_at" + interval '60 minutes')

result_scope.name: result_scope
result_scope.default: 'No result has been prepared or provider action confirmed.'

valo_document_form.name: valo_document_form
valo_document_form.value: ("valo_documents"."form_edition" IS NULL) = ("valo_documents"."form_digest" IS NULL) AND ("valo_documents"."form_edition" IS NULL) = ("valo_documents"."form_version" IS NULL) AND ("valo_documents"."form_version" IS NULL OR "valo_documents"."form_version" = 2) AND ("valo_documents"."form_digest" IS NULL OR "valo_documents"."form_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

valo_document_form_order.name: valo_document_form_order
valo_document_form_order.value: "valo_documents"."form_order" IS NULL OR "valo_documents"."form_edition" IS NOT NULL

valo_document_library_edition.name: valo_document_library_edition
valo_document_library_edition.value: "valo_documents"."library_edition" IS NULL OR ("valo_documents"."form_edition" IS NULL AND "valo_documents"."template_version_id" IS NULL)

valo_edition_notice_shape.name: valo_edition_notice_shape
valo_edition_notice_shape.value: "valo_edition_notices"."route" IN ('library', 'reviewed') AND "valo_edition_notices"."kind" IN ('replaced', 'withdrawn') AND "valo_edition_notices"."documents" >= 0 AND ("valo_edition_notices"."held" OR "valo_edition_notices"."documents" > 0) AND (("valo_edition_notices"."kind" = 'replaced') = ("valo_edition_notices"."replacement_version" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("valo_edition_notices"."reason" IS NULL OR "valo_edition_notices"."kind" = 'withdrawn' OR "valo_edition_notices"."route" = 'library')

valo_workspace_scope.name: valo_workspace_scope
valo_workspace_scope.using: exists (select 1 from valo_support_cases c where c.id = "valo_support_actions"."case_id" and c.workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))
valo_workspace_scope.withCheck: exists (select 1 from valo_support_cases c where c.id = "valo_support_actions"."case_id" and c.workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))

valo_support_case_source.name: valo_support_case_source
valo_support_case_source.value:
("valo_support_cases"."source_kind"='workspace' AND "valo_support_cases"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."access_id" IS NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("valo_support_cases"."source_kind"='access' AND "valo_support_cases"."access_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "valo_support_cases"."workspace_id" IS NULL)

valo_workspace_scope.name: valo_workspace_scope
valo_workspace_scope.using: exists (select 1 from valo_support_cases c where c.id = "valo_support_escalations"."case_id" and c.workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))
valo_workspace_scope.withCheck: exists (select 1 from valo_support_cases c where c.id = "valo_support_escalations"."case_id" and c.workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))

valo_support_escalation_hold_kind.name: valo_support_escalation_hold_kind
valo_support_escalation_hold_kind.value: ("valo_support_escalations"."library_hold_id" IS NULL OR "valo_support_escalations"."target_kind" = 'library') AND ("valo_support_escalations"."source_impact_id" IS NULL OR "valo_support_escalations"."target_kind" <> 'library')

valo_workspace_scope.name: valo_workspace_scope
valo_workspace_scope.using: exists (select 1 from valo_support_cases c where c.id = "valo_support_events"."case_id" and c.workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))
valo_workspace_scope.withCheck: exists (select 1 from valo_support_cases c where c.id = "valo_support_events"."case_id" and c.workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))

valo_source_review_preparations_outcome.name: valo_source_review_preparations_outcome
valo_source_review_preparations_outcome.value:
jsonb_typeof("valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons") = 'array' AND length("valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons"::text) <= 4000
        AND ("valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_version" IS NULL OR "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_version" > 0) AND CASE
        WHEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."status" IN ('pending', 'running') THEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."completed_at" IS NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_artifact_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."held_version_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_version" IS NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons" = '[]'::jsonb
        WHEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."status" = 'prepared' THEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_artifact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."held_version_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons" = '[]'::jsonb
        WHEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."status" = 'held' THEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_artifact_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."held_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons" <> '[]'::jsonb
        WHEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."status" IN ('not_ready', 'failed') THEN "valo_source_review_preparations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_artifact_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."held_version_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons" <> '[]'::jsonb
        ELSE "valo_source_review_preparations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_artifact_id" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."held_version_id" IS NULL
          AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."candidate_version" IS NULL AND "valo_source_review_preparations"."reasons" = '[]'::jsonb
        END

valo_source_register_fields.name: valo_source_register_fields
valo_source_register_fields.value: "valo_source_register"."version" >= 1 AND length("valo_source_register"."source_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length("valo_source_register"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND "valo_source_register"."url" ~ '^https://' AND length("valo_source_register"."jurisdiction") BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND ("valo_source_register"."authority" IS NULL OR length("valo_source_register"."authority") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("valo_source_register"."instrument" IS NULL OR "valo_source_register"."instrument" IN ('act','regulatory_document','official_page')) AND ("valo_source_register"."version_in_force" IS NULL OR length("valo_source_register"."version_in_force") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("valo_source_register"."instrument" IS DISTINCT FROM 'official_page' OR "valo_source_register"."effective_from" IS NULL) AND "valo_source_register"."status" IN ('active','retired') AND length("valo_source_register"."reason") BETWEEN 20 AND 1000

valo_rule_change_shape.name: valo_rule_change_shape
valo_rule_change_shape.value: "valo_rule_changes"."kind" IN ('replaced', 'withdrawn') AND (("valo_rule_changes"."kind" = 'replaced') = ("valo_rule_changes"."replacement_version" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("valo_rule_changes"."replacement_version" IS NULL OR "valo_rule_changes"."replacement_version" > "valo_rule_changes"."version") AND char_length("valo_rule_changes"."reason") BETWEEN 20 AND 1000 AND "valo_rule_changes"."workspaces" >= 0 AND "valo_rule_changes"."results" >= 0 AND "valo_rule_changes"."tasks" >= 0

valo_rule_notice_shape.name: valo_rule_notice_shape
valo_rule_notice_shape.value: "valo_rule_notices"."kind" IN ('replaced', 'withdrawn') AND (("valo_rule_notices"."kind" = 'replaced') = ("valo_rule_notices"."replacement_version" IS NOT NULL)) AND "valo_rule_notices"."results" >= 0 AND "valo_rule_notices"."tasks" >= 0 AND ("valo_rule_notices"."results" > 0 OR "valo_rule_notices"."tasks" > 0)

valo_manual_state.name: valo_manual_state
valo_manual_state.value: "valo_manual_library"."state" IN ('draft','published','replaced','withdrawn') AND (("valo_manual_library"."kind" = 'regulatory_article' AND "valo_manual_library"."state" <> 'draft') = ("valo_manual_library"."regulatory_check_id" IS NOT NULL))

valo_manual_text.name: valo_manual_text
valo_manual_text.value: length("valo_manual_library"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 140 AND length("valo_manual_library"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 60000 AND ("valo_manual_library"."kind" NOT IN ('industry_introduction','industry_pack') OR "valo_manual_library"."industry" IS NOT NULL)

valo_manual_file.name: valo_manual_file
valo_manual_file.value: ("valo_manual_library"."file_bytes" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."file_format" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."kind" NOT IN ('template','premium_template')) OR ("valo_manual_library"."file_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."kind" IN ('template','premium_template') AND "valo_manual_library"."file_format" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."file_format" IN ('pdf','docx') AND octet_length("valo_manual_library"."file_bytes") BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152)

valo_manual_form_text.name: valo_manual_form_text
valo_manual_form_text.value: "valo_manual_library"."form_text" IS NULL OR ("valo_manual_library"."kind" IN ('template','premium_template') AND length("valo_manual_library"."form_text") BETWEEN 1 AND 60000)

valo_manual_entry_details.name: valo_manual_entry_details
valo_manual_entry_details.value: ("valo_manual_library"."purpose" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."needs" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."limits" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."related_items" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."ai_drafted" IS NULL) OR ("valo_manual_library"."kind" IN ('template','premium_template') AND ("valo_manual_library"."purpose" IS NULL OR length("valo_manual_library"."purpose") BETWEEN 1 AND 400) AND ("valo_manual_library"."needs" IS NULL OR length("valo_manual_library"."needs") BETWEEN 1 AND 1600) AND ("valo_manual_library"."limits" IS NULL OR length("valo_manual_library"."limits") BETWEEN 1 AND 800) AND ("valo_manual_library"."related_items" IS NULL OR cardinality("valo_manual_library"."related_items") BETWEEN 1 AND 6))

valo_manual_guidance_record.name: valo_manual_guidance_record
valo_manual_guidance_record.value: ("valo_manual_library"."applies_to" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."action_evidence" IS NULL AND "valo_manual_library"."related_templates" IS NULL) OR ("valo_manual_library"."kind" = 'regulatory_article' AND ("valo_manual_library"."applies_to" IS NULL OR length("valo_manual_library"."applies_to") BETWEEN 1 AND 800) AND ("valo_manual_library"."action_evidence" IS NULL OR length("valo_manual_library"."action_evidence") BETWEEN 1 AND 800) AND ("valo_manual_library"."related_templates" IS NULL OR (cardinality("valo_manual_library"."related_templates") BETWEEN 1 AND 6 AND array_to_string("valo_manual_library"."related_templates", ',') ~ '^TPL-[0-9]{2}(,TPL-[0-9]{2})*$')))

valo_manual_actors.name: valo_manual_actors
valo_manual_actors.value: ("valo_manual_library"."state" = 'draft') = ("valo_manual_library"."published_by" IS NULL) AND ("valo_manual_library"."published_by" IS NULL) = ("valo_manual_library"."published_at" IS NULL) AND ("valo_manual_library"."state" IN ('replaced','withdrawn')) = ("valo_manual_library"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("valo_manual_library"."closed_by" IS NULL) = ("valo_manual_library"."closed_at" IS NULL)

valo_workspace_scope.name: valo_workspace_scope
valo_workspace_scope.using: "valo_payment_events"."reference" in (select reference from valo_orders where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select provider_transaction_id from valo_orders where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select reference from valo_refund_requests where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select provider_id from valo_refund_requests where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select provider_id from valo_payment_disputes where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))
valo_workspace_scope.withCheck: "valo_payment_events"."reference" in (select reference from valo_orders where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select provider_transaction_id from valo_orders where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select reference from valo_refund_requests where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select provider_id from valo_refund_requests where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()) union select provider_id from valo_payment_disputes where workspace_id = (select valo_scope_workspace()))

valo_commercial_settings_value_check.name: valo_commercial_settings_value_check
valo_commercial_settings_value_check.value: CASE WHEN "valo_commercial_settings"."key" IN ('drafting_workspace_daily', 'drafting_daily_in_all') AND jsonb_typeof("valo_commercial_settings"."value") = 'number' THEN ("valo_commercial_settings"."value")::numeric >= 0 AND ("valo_commercial_settings"."value")::numeric = trunc(("valo_commercial_settings"."value")::numeric) WHEN "valo_commercial_settings"."key" = 'purchase_carries_to_later_editions' THEN jsonb_typeof("valo_commercial_settings"."value") = 'boolean' ELSE false END

valo_workspace_exports_check.name: valo_workspace_exports_check
valo_workspace_exports_check.value: "valo_workspace_exports"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("valo_workspace_exports"."checksum" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_workspace_exports"."size" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_workspace_exports"."current_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "valo_workspace_exports"."counts" IS NOT NULL)
